simple.meaning: שְׁפוֹ (Shᵉphôw) is a Hebrew word meaning “Shepho or Shephi , an Idumaean.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: שְׁפוֹ (H8195) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 36:23, with occurrences in Genesis, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שְׁפוֹ (H8195) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in שְׁפוֹ (H8195) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: שְׁפוֹ (Shᵉphôw) / H8195 is traced through Genesis 36:23, 1 Chronicles 1:40 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
